name: polycule
title: polycule
blurb: a The L Word–style interactive relationship-graph maker for the web of bot relationships: add characters, connect them with dating / exes / situationship / throuple / messy-history lines, pin any two toward the center, drag the web around, share what you built. board starts empty — real edges need a citation link and everyone named opting in themselves, not just their partner.
